fields.description: Vindera is a three and four bedroom townhouse neighbourhood in The Valley Phase 2. Emaar places it among gardens, forest walks and Central Park views, with a clubhouse and outdoor spaces intended for family life. The homes combine contemporary façades with private gardens and open-plan living areas.

overview: The brochure describes a neighbourhood shaped around outdoor routines: landscaped walks, places for children to explore and communal spaces for exercise or an evening gathering. Its wider park plan includes an orchard, flower-growing areas, a river landscape and several different play and sports zones. Inside the homes, kitchen, dining and lounge spaces share an open arrangement, with neutral finishes and direct connections to outdoor areas. The clubhouse and leisure pools are resident facilities; the landscape programme extends across the wider community. Confirm which facilities will be available when the selected home is delivered.
research.locationNote: Vindera is in The Valley Phase 2, within Emaar’s Dubai–Al Ain Road community. Check the exact plot, entrance and journey to work or school rather than relying on the brochure’s indicative drive times.
research.priceNote: Emaar currently advertises AED 3.17m. The launch fact sheet lists three-bedroom homes from AED 3.07m and four-bedroom homes from AED 4.14m. These are different published price bases, not confirmation of an available unit; request a dated quotation for the selected home.
research.paymentNote: The Emaar-branded document shows 10% at booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Property Finder instead displays 10/80/10, while Bayut shows 80/20. The document schedule is retained here with the conflict disclosed. Past-due instalments and current terms require confirmation.
research.handoverNote: The project payment sheet estimates December 2029. Both Property Finder and Bayut currently show Q4 2028. The document date is used provisionally; obtain the current developer schedule and contractual handover before making a decision.

facts.label: Launch collection
facts.value: 578 townhouses: 352 three-bedroom and 226 four-bedroom homes. Minimum advertised plots are 1,617 and 2,588 sq ft respectively. These describe the launch collection, not current stock.

facts.label: Layout and area basis
facts.value: Published totals include the suite, garage and balcony/terrace. The four-bedroom four-plex Style 1 has a ground-floor guest bedroom, maid’s room and laundry, with three bedrooms upstairs. Furnishings and landscaped drawings are illustrative.
